title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Peer Proof Harness Work Item
summary: Add repeatable local-loopback, local cross-process, and local external aioquic peer proof for the RFC 9220 WebSocket-over-HTTP/3 tunnel surface.
planned_changes:
- Add an aggregate HTTP/3 loopback test that opens a client WebSocket tunnel through the public client/server APIs.
- Exercise accepted response metadata, server ping with client pong helper behavior, text exchange, buffered binary exchange, client close, and server close echo in one peer-style flow.
- Add a proof script that stores TRX/stdout/stderr plus JSON and Markdown manifests under `.artifacts/http3-websocket-local-peer/<run-id>`.
- Add opt-in sample server/client WebSocket proof modes and a cross-process proof script that starts the sample server process, drives the sample client process, and stores stdout/stderr plus JSON and Markdown manifests under `.artifacts/http3-websocket-cross-process/<run-id>`.
- Add an aioquic 1.3.0 HTTP/3 client proof driver and PowerShell wrapper that starts the Incursa sample server, runs the aioquic client container over Extended CONNECT, records qlog/key-log/process artifacts, and hashes the resulting local external-peer evidence under `.artifacts/http3-websocket-external-aioquic/<run-id>`.
verification_plan: Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/proofs/Invoke-Rfc9220WebSocketLocalPeerProof.ps1 -RunId <run-id>`, run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/proofs/Invoke-Rfc9220WebSocketCrossProcessProof.ps1 -RunId <run-id>`, run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/proofs/Invoke-Rfc9220WebSocketExternalAioquicProof.ps1 -RunId <run-id>`, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage when trace artifacts change, focused WebSocket/proof-harness tests, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Production proxy target, timeout, authorization, or deployment policy.
New RFC 9220 requirement ownership beyond the already trace-owned behavior.
completion_notes: The local-loopback peer proof passed under `.artifacts/http3-websocket-local-peer/20260619T0825Z-local-peer-fragmented-control`. The local cross-process sample proof passed under `.artifacts/http3-websocket-cross-process/20260619T-cross-process-001`. The local external aioquic peer proof passed under `.artifacts/http3-websocket-external-aioquic/20260619T-rfc9220-aioquic-001` using the `incursa-http3-external-interop-aioquic:latest` image at `sha256:b022b70e9f351326bf2951c5a56c5a00808b9f0b226a363d8b1b27014352d975`. These proofs remain explicitly narrower than isolated-host, browser, ProtocolLab publishable, or production proxy evidence.
